correctness.rationale: PASS: At collinear configurations token-score first derivatives vanish along S1 tangents, since all base vectors are parallel to e and tangent perturbations are orthogonal to e. At C and B self-inclusive attention averages equal ±e and ±t e, t=tanh(alpha). The sign-flip conditions are eta*b>1 and eta*b*t>1 (equality is undefined). The one-step tangent Jacobians have plus eigenvalues (1+eta*a)/(eta*b-1) and (1+eta*a)/(eta*b*t-1); minus eigenvalues 1/(eta*b-1) and (1+eta*a*t)/(eta*b*t-1). Exact squared return-map multipliers establish C stability iff eta>2/(b-a) and B iff b*t>a, eta>2/(b*t-a). Consequently B stability implies C stability; for eta>2/(b-a) critical alpha=atanh((a+2/eta)/b). Independent direct full-softmax centered-tangent finite difference agrees within 1.9e-13 for an interior parameter choice. No claim made about nonlinear neutral-equality stability or other attractors.
